grades.quote: When MODE=Direct, all traps into machine mode cause the `pc` to be set to the address in the BASE field. When MODE=Vectored, all synchronous exceptions into machine mode cause the `pc` to be set to the address in the BASE field, whereas interrupts cause the `pc` to be set to the address in the BASE field plus four times the interrupt cause number.
